theories.claim: internal/platform/config/config.go loadFile custom YAML parser creates cross-package integration risk with workspace config supplied via internal/app
theories.basis: loadFile:197-269 implements line-oriented parser using TrimSpace, SplitN on ':', leadingWhitespace check and listConfigField/clearListField; listConfigField:553-560 only recognizes agentwrap.required_health, agentwrap.required_capabilities, agentwrap.extra_args, agentwrap.env, smoke.environment; any qa list fields handled via setQAField would not be cleared by clearListField, and parser rejects lines without ':' , silently ignores unknown list items, and does not support quoted colons, multiline or anchor YAML features that a standard workspace ultraplan.yml author would expect via docs/architecture.md workspace file ownership
theories.verification_surface: internal/platform/config/config.go:197-288 loadFile, 553-575 list handling, and setField delegation to setQAField
theories.confirmation_condition: parser demonstrably rejects or misinterprets a valid workspace YAML construct that Validate would otherwise accept, or listConfigField misses qa list fields defined in qaConfigFields()
theories.refutation_condition: workspace config format is formally defined as the restricted subset implemented by loadFile and callers validate input against that subset only
theories.inconclusive_condition: definition of allowed ultraplan.yml syntax and qa list fields not visible in assigned context_paths (qaEnvOverrides, qaConfigFields, setQAField, validateQA defined outside context_paths)
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read-only inspection of loadFile branching, listConfigField allowlist, and setField delegation; compare against architecture.md State and Artifact Ownership without executing parser
